definitions.gloss: alternative plan; alternative proposal; fallback option
definitions.explanation: A plan or proposal offered in place of another, either as a substitute for one that has been rejected or as a backup in case the first fails.

examples.japanese: {代替案|だいたいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To put forward an alternative plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧なら{代替案|だいたいあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: If you oppose it, you need an alternative proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{代替案|だいたいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おいた。
examples.english: I prepared a fallback plan in case the project was cancelled.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代替案|だいたいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ / ⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to put forward an alternative
- {代替案|だいたいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧: to consider alternatives
- {代替案|だいたいあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no alternative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{代案|だいあん}→代案：22236_daian⟧: the same meaning in a shorter form, common in politics and debate (⟦{代案|だいあん}→代案：22236_daian⟧なき⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧, opposition with no counterproposal). {代替案|だいたいあん} is the usual word in business and planning.
